description: Absorb one request (ticketId, the child) into another (parentTicketId, the parent) in the same project. For duplicates or narrow asks a bigger request subsumes. The child goes DECLINED with a merged_into link + a MERGED journey event (nothing is lost: body, comments, and the reality read stay on it, and the parent's detail lists its absorbed children). When the parent SHIPS, every merged child ships with it automatically and each original requester is notified. Guards: both must be live (not CLOSED/DECLINED), the parent must not itself be merged (no chains), and a request can't merge into itself. For MANAGER+, refused when the parent's title or description repeats what someone wrote in feedback linked to the child.

parentTicketId.description: The request that subsumes it (the parent)
